table.retrieve:
SELECT  SL.saleinvcode,
	ITEMNAME=I.name,
	rowid=Max(SD.rowid),
	stock=max(SD.godownbalancestock),
	packingdesc=Max(I.packingdesc),
	packunits=Max(SD.packunits),
	looseqty=sum(SD.looseqty),
	saleprice=Max(SD.saleprice),
	totalprice=Round(((  sum(SD.looseqty)*(max(SD.saleprice) - max(SD.itemflatdisc)) ) * ( 1 - max(SD.discperc)/100)) * (1 - SL.discperc/100),2),
	Customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=SL.custcode),
	Saletype=(select name from saletype where saletypecode=Max(SL.saletypecode)),
	/*InvTotal=(SELECT 
				netamount= Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 2) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc   +   misccharges, 0) End 
				+
				Round(Sum (Round (  (SD1.looseqty + SD1.bonusqty)*   SD1.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD1.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD1.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
				 +  (Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL1.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL1.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0)
				FROM saleledger SL1,
 						saledetail SD1
   			WHERE ( SL1.saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode AND
						SL1.saleinvcode = SD1.saleinvcode )
				GROUP BY SL1.saleinvcode,
			 				SL1.flatdisc,
		 	 				SL1.misccharges,
                     SL1.discperc,
		        			 SL1.invgstperc1

                  )*/
	InvTotal= Round(((  sum(SD.looseqty)*(max(SD.saleprice) - max(SD.itemflatdisc)) ) * ( 1 - max(SD.discperc)/100)) * (1 - SL.discperc/100),2)
			/* Case When (Select Min(RowId) From SaleDetail Where saleinvcode = SL.Saleinvcode ) = Min(Rowid)
		 Then (SELECT 
				netamount= Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 2) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc   +   misccharges, 0) End 
				+
				Round(Sum (Round (  (SD1.looseqty + SD1.bonusqty)*   SD1.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD1.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD1.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
				 +  (Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL1.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD1.looseqty * (  SD1.saleprice -   SD1.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD1.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL1.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL1.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0)
				FROM saleledger SL1,
 						saledetail SD1
   			WHERE ( SL1.saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode AND
						SL1.saleinvcode = SD1.saleinvcode )
				GROUP BY SL1.saleinvcode,
			 				SL1.flatdisc,
		 	 				SL1.misccharges,
                     SL1.discperc,
		        			 SL1.invgstperc1

                  )
		Else 0
		End

	*/
FROM Item I,
     saleledger SL,
     saledetail SD
WHERE 	SL.date>=:ad_sdate  AND
			SL.date<= :ad_ldate  AND
			SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode AND
			SD.icode=I.icode
GROUP BY 
			SL.saleinvcode, 
         SL.custcode, 
			SL.discperc, 
			SL.flatdisc, 
			SL.misccharges, 
			SL.salestax, 
			SL.remarks,
			SL.custrefno, 
			SD.icode,
			SD.rowgroup, 
			SD.gcode, 
			I.name,
			I.icode,
			I.printable
			
			
ORDER BY SL.saleinvcode, Max(SD.rowid)
